# Captured pdf.js text

Text extracted from real exports by browser pdf.js, paired with the values the
parser found in it. Generated by `node tests/capture-text.mjs <file.pdf>`.

Each `<name>.txt` is replayed through `extract()` and checked against
`<name>.json`. These run in milliseconds and need no PDF, so they are the right
place to lock in a parsing fix — but they only prove `extract()`, not pdf.js
tokenisation. Keep the source PDF in `../pdfs/` too when you can share it.
